PRIZES AND ODDS

During each hourly drawing1, eight winning numbers2 will be selected. Form two or more lines in horizontal, vertical or diagonal directions to win a prize3.

Match	Prize	Odds
7-8 Lines	$25,000	1 in 319,770.0
6 Lines	$500	1 in 5,710.2
5 Lines	$50	1 in 1,343.6
4 Lines	$25	1 in 292.8
3 Lines	$7	1 in 45.1
2 Lines	$2	1 in 10.8


Overall odds of winning a prize are 1 in 8.4

Note: A play that forms 7 lines automatically forms 8 lines.

DISCLAIMERS:

1 Lucky Links can be played from 4:00 AM to 11:59 PM Arizona time, seven days a week with the first draw time at 5:00 AM. Players have until 11:59 PM Arizona time on each day to purchase Lucky Links tickets. Lucky Links last draw will be at 11:00 PM Arizona time.

2 Lottery numbers broadcasted on television or radio, published on the Arizona State Lottery website, or published and/or communicated by other means does not constitute an official representation of the actual winning lottery numbers. The Arizona State Lottery official audited records of numbers drawn will determine the winning numbers for any draw. A draw game prize must be claimed within 180 days of a drawing.

3 Prizes will be pari-mutuel when the total prize for forming 7-8 lines with 5X multiplier drawn is above $125,000. The total prize shall be split into equal shares, one share for each winning $1.00 played, rounded down to the nearest dollar. The prize amount per winner is the prize amount per share times the bet amount.

4 All sales are final. Drawing game tickets cannot be voided.

howToPlay:
HOW TO PLAY
LUCKY LINKS
Step 1,
Pick Your Numbers

This game is Quick Pick only. Eight numbers will be randomly generated for you:

Eight Numbers (1 – 22)
Step 2,
Buy Your Ticket

Each play costs $1. You also have the option to add Super Bonus for $1 to multiply your prize up to 5X.

Your ticket will print with your Quick Pick numbers placed in a 3x3 grid with the center space “Free”.

Quick Draw tickets can be purchased at more than 3,000 Arizona Lottery Retailers.

Step 3,
Check Your Winnings

After the drawing occurs, match the numbers on your ticket to the winning numbers to form any two or more lines in horizontal, vertical, or diagonal directions for a chance to win up to $25,000.
